title: CHAPTER 1: UNDERSTANDING INTERNATIONAL RELATIONS
content: 👋 እንኳን ወደ ክፍለ ትምህርት 1.5 እና 1.6 በሰላም መጣችሁ! በዚህ ትምህርት የዓለም አቀፍ ግንኙነትን በምንመረምርበት ጊዜ የምንጠቀማቸውን አራት ደረጃዎች (Levels of Analysis) እና የዓለም አቀፍ ስርዓቱን መዋቅር (Structure of the International System) በጥልቀት የምናይ ይሆናል። ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ 📌 1.5. Levels of Analysis in International Relations 🔹 Introduction & Importance of Levels of Analysis - In early IR study (1919 to post-WWII), scholars shifted between different organizational levels without systematic boundaries. - J. David Singer (1961) criticized this analytical ambiguity, arguing that a clear level of analysis prevents "analytical cherry-picking" (randomly gathering evidence from conflicting sources). - Kenneth Waltz (1959) in Man, the State and War established a formal framework with three "images": the individual, the state, and the international system. - 👉 የ IR ክስተቶችን ስንመረምር የምንተነተንበትን ደረጃ (Level) በግልጽ ማወቅ አላስፈላጊ መረጃዎችን ከመቀላቀልና ከተሳሳተ ድምዳሜ ከመድረስ ይጠብቀናል። 🔹 1.5.1. The Individual Level - Focuses on the behaviors, motivations, beliefs, psychology, and choices of key individual leaders or actors. - Analyzes how human nature, emotions, fears, visions, and perceptions affect foreign policy decisions. - Example: Explaining Chancellor Angela Merkel's 2015 decision on Syrian refugees by studying her personal background, leadership style, and values. - 👉 በዚህ ደረጃ የፖለቲካ መሪዎች ግላዊ ስብዕና፣ ስነ-ልቦና፣ እምነት እና ውሳኔ አሰጣጥ በዓለም አቀፍ ሁኔታዎች ላይ የሚያሳድረው ተጽዕኖ ይተነተናል። 🔹 1.5.2. The Group Level - Analyzes how domestic interest groups, technocratic circles, political parties, voting blocs, and social movements influence state policies. - Focuses on collective dynamics such as lobby group influence on foreign policy or activist networks (e.g., Anonymous). - Example: The 2008 global financial crisis viewed as the "misrule of experts" and unmonitored technocratic circles in corporate boards. - 👉 በዚህ ደረጃ የመንግሥት ውሳኔዎችን የሚቀይሩ የቡድኖች፣ የፖለቲካ ፓርቲዎች እና የህዝብ እንቅስቃሴዎች (Social Movements) ሚና ይታያል። 🔹 1.5.3. The State Level - Maintains a "state-centric" view where the sovereign state is the primary unit of analysis and the central location of political power. - Considers states as unified actors with specific preferences, analyzing their domestic cohesion, regime types, economic standings, and bilateral interactions. - States retain what Max Weber termed the monopoly on the legitimate use of physical force within their boundaries. - 👉 ሀገርን እንደ ዋና ተዋናይ በመውሰድ የውጭ ፖሊሲዋን (Foreign Policy)፣ የመንግሥት ስርዓቷን፣ የኢኮኖሚና የወታደራዊ አቅሟን ማዕከል አድርጎ መተንተን ነው። 🔹 1.5.4. The System Level - Positions the global system as the overarching structure or context within which all actors operate. - Focuses on macro-level dynamics: distribution of power among great powers, international law, global economic trends, internet connectivity, and transnational terrorism. - Assumes the system is inherently anarchic (lacking a world government). - 👉 ከሀገራት በላይ ያለውን አጠቃላይ የዓለም አቀፍ ስርዓት መዋቅር፣ የኃይል ሚዛን (Balance of Power) እና ዓለም አቀፍ ኢኮኖሚን በሰፊው የሚተነተንበት ደረጃ ነው። 💡 Exam Hint: የ Kenneth Waltz ሦስት ምስሎች (Individual, State, System) እና Singer የጠቀሱት የ Analysis ደረጃዎች ለፈተና በብዛት የሚጠየቁ ናቸው! ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ 📌 1.6. The Structure of International System 🔹 Polarity in the International System - Polarity refers to how political, military, and economic power is distributed among global actors. - 1. Unipolar System: A single dominant state holds overwhelming political, economic, and military power, effectively controlling or leading the system. - 2. Bipolar System: Power is concentrated around two dominant superpowers competing against each other. Less powerful states form opposing alliance blocs. - Example: The Cold War era between the US and the USSR. - Risk: Zero-sum game politics where a gain for one superpower is automatically perceived as a loss for the other. - 3. Multipolar System: Power is distributed among three or more roughly equal great powers competing and forming fluid alliances. - Example: Pre-World War I Europe. - 👉 ፖላሪቲ በዓለም አቀፍ ደረጃ ያለው የኃይል ስርጭት ሲሆን በሦስት ይከፈላል፡ Unipolar (አንድ አያሌ ሀገር)፣ Bipolar (ሁለት ታላላቅ ኃይሎች - ለምሳሌ የቅዝቃዛው ጦርነት)፣ እና Multipolar (ብዙ እኩል አቅም ያላቸው ሀገራት)። 🔹 Power in International Relations - Power is defined as the "currency" or "bloodline" of international politics. - Hans Morgenthau: Defined international politics as a continuous struggle for power. - Relational Power (Robert Dahl): Defined as state A's ability to get state B to do something B would not otherwise do. - Material Power: Refers to tangible capabilities (military size, economic wealth, industrial output). - 👉 ኃይል በዓለም አቀፍ ፖለቲካ ልክ እንደ ገንዘብ ወሳኝ መለኪያ ነው። ሮበርት ዳህል እንደገለጹት ኃይል ማለት ሀገር 'A' ሀገር 'B'ን ያለፍላጎቷ አንድን ነገር እንድታደርግ የማስገደድ አቅም ነው። 🔹 Anarchy - Refers to the absence of a central overarching government or supreme legal authority above sovereign states in the global realm. - Does not mean total chaos, but rather a decentralized self-help system where each state must ensure its own security through national capabilities or alliances. - 👉 አናርኪ ማለት በዓለም አቀፍ ደረጃ ሀገራትን የሚያስተዳድር ወይም የሚያስገድድ የበላይ መንግሥት አለመኖር (Absence of Global Government) ማለት ነው። 🔹 Sovereignty - The ultimate authority of a state consisting of two distinct dimensions: 1. Internal Sovereignty: Exclusive supreme authority to govern domestic affairs within its borders. 2. External Sovereignty: Autonomy to conduct foreign relations without external dictate or intervention. - 👉 ሶቨሪንቲ (ሉዓላዊነት) ማለት ሀገር በውስጥ አስተዳደሯ (Internal) እና በውጭ ግንኙነቷ (External) ላይ ሙሉ ነጻነትና የበላይ ስልጣን ሲኖራት ነው። ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ 👋 የክፍል 1.5 እና 1.6 ትምህርታችን በስኬት ተጠናቋል። በሚቀጥለው ክፍል (PART 4) የ IR ዋና ዋና ቲዮሪዎችን (Realism, Liberalism, Constructivism) በጥልቀት የምናይ ይሆናል። በርቱ፣ ሰላማችሁ ይብዛ! 🙏🙏🙏
